literature_notes: The sole ledger entry (L1) reports full-length IGDCC4 cloned with a Myc tag at the C-terminus. Computed topology places the C-terminus (residue 1250) firmly in the intracellular domain (residues 977–1250), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space. L1 also mentions two truncated constructs — IGDCC4-extracellular and IGDCC4-cytoplasmic domain — each with a C-terminal Myc tag; the ectodomain construct is a soluble secreted fragment (not a full-length membrane-anchored protein) and is therefore disqualified under the ledger rules, and the cytoplasmic construct is intracellular. No ledger line reports any insertion on the extracellular face of IGDCC4. The mature N-terminus (residue 25, extracellular) and the large extracellular domain (residues 25–955) are topologically available, but no published tolerated insertion grounds a site there. Zero extracellular surface tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: Full-length IGDCC4 carries a C-terminal Myc tag at residue 1250, which lies in the intracellular domain (residues 977–1250); tolerated in the full-length construct but not on the extracellular face.
